PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (14, 8, 22),       # PMOS pair gm/Id
    "Lin": (0.18, 0.15, 0.6),     # PMOS pair L (small -> low o1 capacitance)
    "gmid_ld": (11, 6, 16),       # NMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lld": (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # NMOS mirror load L
    "Wn1": (0.42, 0.42, 1.2),     # inverter-1 nfet W
    "Linv1": (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),   # inverter-1 L
    "dtrip": (-0.05, -0.15, 0.08),# trip-point trim vs balanced o1 level [V]
    "Wn2": (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),      # inverter-2 nfet W
    "Wp2": (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),      # inverter-2 pfet W
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = 10e-6
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    Ih = iref / 2

    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["Lin"], Ih, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ld"], p["Lld"], Ih, vds=0.6)
    vbal = m3.vgs

    vt = min(max(vbal + p["dtrip"], 0.4), 1.3)
    L1 = p["Linv1"]
    on = lut.op("n", p["Wn1"], L1, vt, 0.9)
    op1 = lut.op("p", 1.0, L1, 1.8 - vt, 0.9)
    Wp1 = p["Wn1"] * on["Id"] / max(op1["Id"], 1e-12)
    Wp1 = min(max(Wp1, 0.42), 20.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "ibias", "vdd", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "ibias", "vdd", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.M("MN1", "o2", "o1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn1"], L1)
    n.M("MP1", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, L1)
    n.M("MN2", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn2"], 0.15)
    n.M("MP2", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp2"], 0.15)

    # predictions: o1 slews from a rail to the trip point on tanh-limited current
    gain = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    cg1 = (on.get("cgg", 0.0) or 0.0) + (op1.get("cgg", 0.0) or 0.0) * Wp1
    cinv1 = max(cg1, 0.8e-15 * (p["Wn1"] + Wp1) * L1 / 0.15)
    c1 = m1.cdd + m1.cgd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd + 2.0 * cinv1 + 1e-15
    i_sig = max(2 * Ih * math.tanh(vod * m1.gm_id / 2.0), 1e-9)
    dv_up = max(vt - 0.07, 0.05)
    dv_dn = max(min(1.6, 1.8 - m1.vgs) - vt, 0.05)
    dv = max(dv_up, dv_dn)
    t1 = 1.3 * c1 * dv / i_sig
    cinv2 = 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn2"] + p["Wp2"]) + 1e-15
    i1 = max(on["Id"] * 3, 5e-6)
    t2 = cinv2 * 0.9 / i1
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / (120e-6 * min(p["Wn2"], p["Wp2"] / 2.5))
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = 1.8 * iref * 1.05
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain1": gain, "vo1_bal": vbal, "Wp1": Wp1, "c1": c1}
